name: Train and Nourish
description: Women-only personal training and nutrition studios in Philadelphia, Ardmore, and West Chester. Founded by Jenna Reilly. Book a free consult.

hero.headline: Weight training without the gym intimidation
hero.sub: Train and Nourish is Jenna Reilly’s women-only studio. Five locations: East Passyunk, Art Museum, Fishtown, Ardmore, West Chester. Private training, small classes, nutrition coaching.

offerings.heading: Train. Nourish. Stay.
items: 1-on-1 and semi-private training with female coaches in a women-only room.
Small group classes capped at 11, modified to the body in front of them.
Virtual nutrition coaching for energy, weight, and hormones.

gallery.heading: Bright rooms, real barbells, no audience.

story.heading: Born from gym intimidation
paragraphs: Jenna Reilly built Train and Nourish because her clients felt watched on a gym floor and stuck on cardio machines. The studios are private and women-only on purpose.
East Passyunk is 1621 East Passyunk Ave, (267) 710-7744. Art Museum 559 North 20th St.

experience.heading: A free 30-minute consult.
items: You talk goals and history. They build a plan.
Beginners, pregnancy, injury, peri-menopause: the site names those rooms on purpose.
You leave knowing which studio and which coach.

feature.heading: Five studios, one standard
feature.text: East Passyunk, Art Museum, Fishtown, Ardmore, West Chester. Same idea in each: female coaches, a private room, weight training taught as a skill.

spotlight.heading: Nutrition sits next to the barbell

contact.heading: Pick the studio.
contact.sub: Start at 1621 East Passyunk Ave, or confirm the other four on the official site.
